units.joint_pos: rad (absolute qpos of the actuated joints, not minus nominal)
units.last_action: policy action units (the chosen, undelayed action of the previous step; = obs prev-action * 10)
units.base_lin_vel: m/s, trunk-origin linear velocity qvel[0:3] expressed in the IMU frame
units.imu_height: m, IMU site height over the ground (env robot_imu_height_over_ground)
units.roll_pitch: rad, euler 'xyz' of the IMU orientation (env imu_orientation_euler[0:2])
units.base_xy: m, world frame, trunk origin qpos[0:2]
units.base_yaw: rad, world frame, euler 'xyz'[2] of the IMU orientation

notes.imu_ang_vel: from data of the last physics substep start; unchanged by shocks (see module doc)
notes.projected_gravity: redundant with roll_pitch (g = [sin p, -cos p sin r, -cos p cos r]); kept because the policy reads it
notes.base_xy: absolute; use to_window_frame for the window-start frame
notes.base_yaw: absolute, wrapped to (-pi, pi]; use to_window_frame

units.jnt_axis: unit vectors of the hinge joints
units.jnt_range: rad, [lo, hi] per hinge joint (locked joints: nominal +- 0.001)
units.nominal_joint_pos: rad (PD target = nominal + action * action_scaling + joint_position_offset)
units.joint_max_vel: rad/s (joint qvel clip after each control step)

layout: one directory per shard (checkpoint x setting); every field is <name>.npy (np.load(mmap_mode='r'))

x_plus.doc: x^+_t: state the policy acted on at t (after the reset if t starts an episode)

x_minus_next.doc: x^-_{t+1}: after physics + qvel clip, before shock / DR (recorded before any reset)

x_plus_next.doc: x^+_{t+1}: after shock / DR, before any reset (= x_plus[t+1] unless done[t])

u_policy.doc: deterministic policy action at t (on the noisy observation obs[t])

u_cmd.doc: action sent to the env = u_policy + action noise (chosen, undelayed; = last_action of x at t+1)

u_applied.doc: u~_t: delayed action the PD controller used = delay_step(delay_buffer[t], u_cmd[t], delay_steps[t])[0]

delay_buffer.doc: env action_history before step t (oldest first)

delay_steps.doc: realized delay of step t (control steps)

xi_idx.doc: row of xi_table active during the physics of step t

xi_next_idx.doc: row of xi_table after the DR step of t (before any reset); differs from xi_idx iff dr_resampled_next

command.doc: velocity command in the observation at t (vx, vy, yaw rate)

obs.doc: policy observation at t as the policy saw it (with observation noise)

dr_resampled_next.doc: DR resampled between x^-_{t+1} and x^+_{t+1}

terminated.doc: transition t ended in a termination (fall / qvel limit)

truncated.doc: transition t hit the episode time limit (and did not terminate)

done.doc: terminated | truncated (the env reset after t)

noise_on.doc: action noise was added at t

episode_id.doc: episode counter per env (0 = first episode of the shard)

episode_step.doc: step index within the episode (0 = first state after a reset; mask this transition, see wm_state doc)

fail_within.doc: actual: a termination in transitions t..t+H-1 of the same episode, H in label_horizons

fail_within_mask.doc: label known (failure seen, or H transitions observed before truncation / window end)

xi_table.doc: distinct xi vectors of the shard

oracle_u0.doc: first oracle action = policy on the noise-free o(x_plus[t])

oracle_x_plus_next.doc: oracle states after each branch step (no shocks, so x^+ == x^-)

oracle_terminated.doc: oracle step k terminated (only the first one matters)

oracle_first_failure.doc: first terminated step k (0 = the first transition); H if none

oracle_fail_within_mask.doc: oracle label known (not truncated before H)

oracle_critic_p_safe.doc: this checkpoint's safety critic: ensemble-mean P(safe) for (obs[t], u_policy[t]) (NaN without critic)

oracle_obs_full.doc: full env observation at t (noisy; critic input together with history)

oracle_history_stack.doc: env history stack at t (input of the history encoder -> latent z of any critic)
